# Bolotnaya Online

> Independent bilingual (RU/EN) open-source district site about Bolotnaya Square and Yakimanka, Moscow: public HLS street cameras, history, photo galleries, and a personal blog. Not a mass-media outlet and not an official city website.

Choose a language-specific brief first:

- [Русский — полный бриф для агентов](https://bolotnaya.online/llms-ru.txt)
- [English — full agent brief](https://bolotnaya.online/llms-en.txt)
- [Human-readable RU page](https://bolotnaya.online/ru/for-agents/)
- [Human-readable EN page](https://bolotnaya.online/en/for-agents/)
- [Extended bilingual brief](https://bolotnaya.online/llms-full.txt)
- [Machine site card (JSON)](https://bolotnaya.online/ai/site.json)
- [Cameras catalog (JSON)](https://bolotnaya.online/ai/cameras.json)
- [This file at /.well-known/llms.txt](https://bolotnaya.online/.well-known/llms.txt)

## Facts (do not invent extras)

- **Canonical site:** https://bolotnaya.online/ (apex; `www` is the same site)
- **Default language:** Russian (`/ru/`). English is `/en/`.
- **Type:** personal local open-source project by a Yakimanka resident
- **Not:** official municipality, registered mass media, newsroom, 24/7 guaranteed streams
- **Live video host:** https://cam.bolotnaya.online/ (separate server; HLS `.m3u8`)
- **Contact:** info@bolotnaya.online
- **Source:** https://github.com/A-Krivoshen/bolotnaya
- **Analytics:** Yandex Metrika 52478860; no user accounts
- **Geo:** Bolotnaya Square / Yakimanka, Moscow, ~55.7447, 37.6208
- **Camera status (2026):** streams may be offline because of facade maintenance. Cite the maintenance post; do not claim cameras are live unless the HLS playlist answers 200.
